description: CSUTLDTC, the called date-validation subprogram, invoked as the @Service it became. LS-DATE='1582-10-15' and LS-DATE-FORMAT='YYYY-MM-DD' are this case's two LINKAGE SECTION parameters (L84-L85); LS-RESULT PIC X(80) (L86) is the output and is asserted below as the single WS_MESSAGE_80 line. This program opens no file and is reached by no JCL, so it seeds no dataset, writes no record and takes no job parameter - its entire observable behaviour is the 80 bytes L97 moves into LS-RESULT and the severity L98 moves into RETURN-CODE. Expected values are STATICALLY DERIVED from the 01 WS-MESSAGE declaration at L42-L57 and the group move at L122, never captured from a COBOL run, which is impossible here. Arm 1 at the LOWER BOUNDARY of the supported range. 15 October 1582 is the Lillian epoch - day one of the count CEEDAYS returns in OUTPUT-LILLIAN (L41, L119) - so it converts, while case10 one day earlier does not. Pinning both sides of the boundary is what stops an off-by-one there passing as a range check that merely looks right.
